collection.description: A villager feels watched by the forest and wonders whether Isola itself is alive.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager feels watched by the forest, hears a strange hum, notices repeating dreams, and wonders whether Isola itself is alive.

choices.label: Consider spirits - or reject the premise

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They experiment with attention and will, discovering changes in their own perception but no conclusive proof.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They track wind, animals, and sleep patterns; several clues fit, others remain puzzling.

c__fx.name: Answer C
c__fx.text: Prayer comforts one villager; another laughs at the idea of a living island. Neither is punished for believing differently.

c__text.name: Answer C
